description: Quranic passages inside the approved adhkar dataset (D-019, D-055). The dataset spells them in a non-Uthmani way, so the app shows these ayahs from the approved Tanzil text instead. 'brackets': the passage is the part of the dataset text between U+FD3F and U+FD3E; 'whole': the whole dataset text is the passage. scripts/import-adhkar.ts checks every mapping against the Quran text (normalized word overlap) and stops if it does not match.
reviewedBy: generated 2026-10-09 from the dataset's own references (e.g. [البقرة 285 - 286]) and checked automatically; awaiting owner review
